Name: More Doghouses for Alternative Textures
Author: LCKa
Description:
DellyBelly's mod, available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30266]here[/url], allows us to buy 16 new doghouses at Marnie's in bright colors, with red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, and pink roofs. This mod simply makes them available through Alternative Textures, so that you can change your doghouses' appearances at any time, regardless of if they're the normal or dark version.

DellyBelly graciously gave permission for this conversion, and all the assets are theirs. Thank you, DellyBelly. Any kudos should go to them, but if you have technical troubles, ask me, please.

This mod pairs nicely with More Pet Bowls, also created by DellyBelly, that has the same color palette. That mod is available in its Content Patcher version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22161]here[/url], and here is its Alternative Textures [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31708]version[/url].

To use Alternative Textures, remember to buy the paint bucket at Robin's, and choose whichever texture you like.
Should work on old and new saves alike.
